She has fair, luminous skin, striking light hazel-gray eyes accentuated with soft smoky eyeshadow and long, dramatic false lashes, sculpted arched eyebrows, subtly contoured cheeks with a warm peachy blush, and full, matte mauve-brown lips. She wears a delicate pearl choker necklace resting just below her collarbone, adding a touch of classic elegance. Her outfit is a black ribbed off-the-shoulder long-sleeve top that exposes her shoulders and collarbones, paired with light-wash denim jeans visible at the lower frame, creating a casual-chic contrast against the refined makeup and jewelry. She is positioned facing the camera directly, shoulders relaxed and slightly angled, with her head tilted very slightly, gazing straight into the lens with a calm, confident, faintly sultry expression. The composition is a vertical portrait, framed from the mid-torso up, centered subject with generous negative space on either side. The background is a plain, seamless off-white to light gray studio backdrop, softly lit to create gentle gradient shadows that add depth without distraction. Lighting is soft, diffused studio lighting from the front-left, mimicking a large softbox or window light, producing smooth highlights on the cheekbones and a subtle falloff shadow on the right side of the face, with no harsh contrast. Shot as if captured on a full-frame camera with an 85mm portrait lens at a wide aperture around f/1.8-f/2.2, giving a shallow depth of field that gently blurs the background while keeping the eyes and lips tack-sharp. The color palette is muted and neutral: soft ivory and gray tones in the background, deep black in the clothing, warm skin tones, and a pop of cool white from the pearls. The overall mood is polished, elegant, and quietly confident, blending high-fashion beauty photography with an approachable, editorial lifestyle feel. Skin texture should look natural and realistic, not overly airbrushed, with fine detail retained in hair strands, fabric ribbing, and pearl texture. Ideal for beauty, fashion, or lifestyle content requiring a striking yet natural close-up portrait.
